name: hyperion-plan
description: Interactive Markdown plans with a local TypeScript CLI

interface.shortDescription: Plan, select, and track work in an inline card.
interface.longDescription: Maintain Markdown task plans, preserve execution approvals and completed history, and render interactive cards through Visualize. Includes a compiled on-demand Node CLI; no server or hooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $hyperion-plan to make an interactive plan for this task.
